The '''Trogan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]].

==History==
This was the location that [[Aves]] and the rest of [[Talon Karrde]]'s organization had used in which to hole up after Karrde's imprisonment. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was sent there to bring the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to the ''[[Katana]]'' fleet ahead of [[Borsk Fey'lya]]'s crew.
